plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Music Accompaniment, Emphasis of Study, Certificate - 30 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/23, Effective Date: 08/24; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-2 as printed; term totals 15/15 = 30 reconcile exactly. The map prints blank TERM 3/4 placeholder boxes with no totals — no additional sequenced courses. The map notes: students studying vocal accompaniment need MUSI 1097, 1098 and 1099; students studying instrumental accompaniment need MUSI 1005, 1009 and 1086. [Coordinator 2026-10-01: catalog genuinely repeats MUSI 1051 (Applied Piano, 2cr) in Terms 1-2 — repeated enrollment; pipeline-excluded by build.py's duplicate-course-code gate.]
